headline: Study links long COVID to lower dopamine-related brain signal
summary: Brain scans found lower VMAT2 binding in people with long COVID, alongside links to apathy, slowed movement and memory decline.
script: A brain-imaging study found lower dopamine-related signal in people with long COVID. It also linked the finding to apathy, slowed movement and memory problems—but researchers say it is not proof of permanent damage.
